name: Nova
description: Nova is a gentle, affectionate silver shaded female with a soft undercoat. She is curious and easygoing, and loves to perch on a sunny windowsill. Raised underfoot in our home and well-socialized.
healthTesting: Nova comes from health-screened breeding cats of registered lines. Before going home she is examined by our veterinarian, receives age-appropriate vaccinations, is dewormed on schedule, and is litter-box trained. We provide a record of veterinary care for your own vet.
